tools.name: render_mermaid_diagram
tools.description: Render a Mermaid diagram into styled SVG vector image code and node metadata. Supports flowchart/graph and sequenceDiagram (sequence) types. Other types (ER/gantt/mindmap/pie/state) should be rendered on client-side using mermaid.js.

tools.name: extract_markdown_outline
tools.description: Extract hierarchical headings, table of contents, word/character statistics, and document structure outline from Markdown text.

tools.name: convert_markdown_to_pdf
tools.description: Compile Markdown text into a styled, publication-ready PDF document with automatic pagination and headers.

tools.name: parse_pdf_to_markdown
tools.description: Extract structured Markdown, tables, and mathematical formulas from a base64 encoded PDF using AI vision OCR.

tools.name: image_ocr_recognize
tools.description: Extract multilingual text, complex headings, formulas, and tabular data from images using multimodal AI vision.

tools.name: assist_ocr_text
tools.description: AI assistant to translate, proofread, or summarize extracted OCR document text.

tools.name: inspect_media_security
tools.description: Deeply inspect image, video, or audio files for privacy leaks, including GPS physical coordinates, camera/recorder hardware serials, recording timestamps, and editing software signatures.

tools.name: sanitize_media_security
tools.description: Permanently wipe and sanitize privacy metadata from image, video, or audio files (strip GPS coordinates, device fingerprints, timestamps, and comments) with zero quality loss.
